bottlenecks_identified: UNPRECEDENTED^2 — SLOWEST-5 IDENTICAL FOR THREE CONSECUTIVE MILESTONES: Exp 786, 527, 491, 627, 603 appear unchanged in .60, .61, AND .62 slowest-5. In .61 we noted 'first time in project history zero composition change occurred.' In .62 it has happened for two consecutive pairs: .60→.61 and .61→.62. The project has never had a three-peat. This is not statistical noise — all five experiments are sourced from unguarded historical queues with no timeout governance. The probability of this happening by chance is negligible: it is a direct consequence of zero action taken on retro recommendations.

DOCUMENTATION-WITHOUT-APPLICATION LOOP (NOW 4th CONSECUTIVE MILESTONE): Nine improvement actions were documented in .61 retro. Three more were documented in .60 retro. Core actions — manifest enforcement, timeout watchdog, DualGPU migration, paragraph batching — have been written in .58, .60, .61, and .62 retros without implementation. At four consecutive milestones of non-implementation, the retro process has zero operational effect. The retro is functioning as a documentation artifact, not a change-management tool. The MILESTONE_PREREQS.md gate recommended in .61 was also not implemented.

EXP 527 — 9th+ POST-RETIREMENT APPEARANCE, SEVEN CONSECUTIVE RETRO RECOMMENDATIONS NOT APPLIED: Exp 527 retired in .57. Conductor-cycle manifest enforcement confirmed since .58. Full-milestone appearances: .58, .59, .60, .61, .62 — five documented post-retirement full-milestone executions. Cumulative post-retirement waste since retirement: ~468 min (7.8 hours). The fix is a 30-60 minute code change in scripts/research_conductor.py. The payback is 52 min/milestone immediately, ~468 min already wasted. Seven retro recommendations not applied. This is the project's most actionable single-item ROI.

GATE SHIFT WITHOUT RESOLUTION — SOTA CODE REPAIR BLOCKED 6TH CONSECUTIVE MILESTONE: RETRO-028 closed in .62 (Exp 810). The gate immediately shifted to RETRO-GGUF-CACHE-IMPORT (Exp 811, Python ImportError on carnot.pipeline.gguf_cache). The underlying 35B GGUF model has never produced a single code repair result in six consecutive milestones. Each milestone a new gatekeeper appears: OOM → ImportError. The fix (create carnot/pipeline/gguf_cache.py with GGUFCacheResolver) is a 1-2 hour implementation that has been explicitly described in the .62 conductor-cycle retro.

INJECTION NON-DISCRIMINATION CASCADE BLOCKER: Exp 812 shows energy_delta identical for error and clean responses (both -0.2884%). IsingConstraintInjector is wired but inverts the polarity — it reduces energy for all responses equally. This cascades to block Exp 813 (constraint addition live) and Exp 814 (FR-11 Tier 1 relay). Until polarity is fixed, three downstream experiments remain gated.

ARBITER FLAT ENERGY — MULTI-AGENT ARBITER NON-FUNCTIONAL: Exp 817 all_scores=0.0 for every response in every scenario. Arbiter defaults to list-order (first response wins). Accuracy = 33% (equivalent to random-first on 3-way choice). The Multi-Agent Arbiter MCP tool is deployed but the EBM scoring function returns trivial values. Real energy computation (IsingEBM or Boltzmann embedding distance to constraint store) is required before the tool provides any signal.

SEQUENTIAL GPU USE WITH SLIGHT THERMAL IMPROVEMENT BUT STRUCTURAL UNDERUTILIZATION: GPU 1 temperature at close = 41C (vs .61: 38C), GPU 0 = 50C (vs .61: 48C). Thermal differential = 9C (vs .61: 10C — slight improvement). Both at 4MB/0% utilization. With RETRO-028 closed, GPU 1 is now fully available for training-heavy experiments. DualGPU validated at 1.8319x speedup (Exp 746) but Exp 603, Exp 491, and JEPA diagnostics all ran sequentially on GPU 0. The DualGPU case is now stronger than ever and still unapplied.

EXPERIMENT COUNT GROWTH STRUCTURALLY OUTPACING RETIREMENT: 704 experiments in .62 vs 679 (.61), +25 this milestone. The recommended cap of 700 was exceeded. At 5.0 min/experiment, 25 new experiments contribute ~125 min of structural overhead added this milestone (vs +85 min in .61 for +17 experiments). The growth rate is accelerating (+8 more experiments than .61 added). Without a hard cap and mandatory retirement sweep before new experiments queue, experiment count growth guarantees wall-time regression regardless of per-experiment efficiency.

Validate: after injection, error_energy > clean_energy for all test pairs. Until fixed, Exp 813 (constraint addition live) and Exp 814 (FR-11 Tier 1) remain cascade-blocked.
